cfr.method: Check the presentation timestamps of all encoded video packets, sorted into presentation order; frame decode count independently checked during registration.

source_picture.method: Full-duration SSIM between encoded source rectangle and original source decoded, rounded to the 60fps grid and Lanczos-scaled identically. Original source PTS preserved.
